name: OpenAPI Spec Generator
description: Auto-generate OpenAPI 3.x specs from code, traffic logs, or packet captures — with interactive refinement.

scripts.description: CLI script implementing all workflow steps (scan/infer/generate/validate/mock)

workflowSteps.name: Endpoint Discovery
workflowSteps.output: Endpoint list with method + path templates

workflowSteps.name: Parameter Classification
workflowSteps.output: Parameter list with type, location, required flag

steps: Run: openapi-gen.sh scan ~/projects/user-service/ — discovers endpoints and detects framework
Run: openapi-gen.sh infer ~/projects/user-service/ — reviews inferred schemas
Run: openapi-gen.sh generate ~/projects/user-service/ --output openapi.yaml — generates validated spec
